question: Which cricketer was named the ICC Women’s Player of the Month for December 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is Annabel Sutherland

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

 
• Annabel Sutherland (Australia) won ICC Women’s Player of the Month for her exceptional all-round performances. In December, she scored 269 runs at 67.25 and took nine wickets across five ODIs. Her remarkable feats included a 110-run knock against India and a 105-run performance against New Zealand, earning her two Player of the Series</s
